name: invalid-extract-values-non-string
description: extract.values entries that are not strings (number, boolean, object) must be REJECTED with zod's exact record-value issue message.
yaml:
appId: dev.atomyx.demo
name: Extract non-string values
---
- capture: "POST /api/v1/auth/login as: loginRsp"
- extract:
    from: loginRsp
    values:
      accessToken: 42
      isAdmin: true
      profile: { name: value }
